frontmatter.name: plan
frontmatter.description: Explore first, then produce a written implementation plan for a task before any file is edited. Use for any change touching more than one file, any new screen or endpoint, or when the request is ambiguous.
frontmatter.allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash(git status *), Bash(git diff *), Bash(git log *), Bash(graphify *)

frontmatter.name: checkpoint
frontmatter.description: Save session state to files before compaction or end of session. Updates activeContext.md, records new decisions as ADRs, adds gaps, refreshes the knowledge graph, and summarises what to carry forward. Use after a milestone, before /compact, or when context is getting long.
frontmatter.argument-hint: [optional one-line summary of what just happened]
frontmatter.allowed-tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash(git status *), Bash(git diff --stat *), Bash(graphify *)

frontmatter.name: commit
frontmatter.description: Review the working tree, verify claims, and create a well-formed git commit. User-invoked only. Never pushes unless asked.
frontmatter.allowed-tools: Bash(git status *), Bash(git diff *), Bash(git log *), Bash(git add *), Bash(git commit *), Bash(git push *), Read, Grep, Agent

frontmatter.name: code-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Reviews a diff or a set of files for correctness, security, trading safety, product-identity and traceability defects. Use before commits and after any feature implementation. Read-only; reports findings ranked by severity.

frontmatter.name: fact-checker
frontmatter.description: Use after Claude has made claims about what code does, what tests passed, what a library supports, or what an API returns. Invoke before any commit, before any user-facing summary, and after any task that added a dependency. Verifies claims with evidence; writes no code.

frontmatter.name: frontend-design
frontmatter.description: Design pass for a HapieCoin screen or component before building it. Produces an intentional layout, states, and token usage that match the Obsidian Desk system, and checks the user's "no confusion" bar. Use before creating any new screen, panel, table or chart in apps/web or mockup-v2.

frontmatter.name: new-skill
frontmatter.description: Turn a prompt you keep repeating into a reusable project skill. Scaffolds .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with correct frontmatter and a checklist body, then explains how to invoke and test it.

frontmatter.name: review
frontmatter.description: Run the code-reviewer and fact-checker subagents on the current changes (or a named path) and merge their reports. Use after implementing a feature and before /commit.
frontmatter.allowed-tools: Agent, Bash(git status *), Bash(git diff *), Read, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: debug-loop
frontmatter.description: Keep a compact working record during a multi-step debugging or fix loop so the session stays usable and survives compaction. Use when an error takes more than two attempts, when tests keep failing, or when many tool outputs are piling up.
frontmatter.argument-hint: [what you are debugging, or "close" when done]
frontmatter.allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash(git status *), Bash(git diff --stat *)

frontmatter.name: digest
frontmatter.description: Run a noisy command (tests, QA, build, lint, log read, Playwright) in an isolated subagent and return only the signal. Use whenever output would exceed about 40 lines, so raw logs never enter the main conversation.
frontmatter.argument-hint: [command to run, or "file <path>" to digest an existing log]
